analysis:
Examined all four primary analyses and the available replayed source, treating prior conclusions as unverified. No independently supported security regression is established in this evidence.

The provider build action defaults save-caches to false and gates Swift, SwiftPM repository and Metal cache writes on explicit permission (.github/actions/provider-ci-build/action.yml HEAD:7–9,107,116,143). New SwiftPM keys bind OS, workspace/home layout, lane and lockfiles, with broader lane-specific fallback restoration. This resolves the local question about enforcement inside the composite action, but the replay omits ci.yml callers and cache-key/content-validation helpers. Git connectivity validation alone does not authenticate cached configuration or hooks; no available source establishes an adversarial writer into a trusted cache scope, so poisoning is not a finding.

component-changes.yml:12–13,28,39 exports mimo_audio from scripts/ci-component-paths.py. The classifier implementation and ci.yml gate consumers are not replayed, so whether all audio admission/release inputs and every master push trigger the gate remains material and unresolved. docs-impact.yml:59–75 preserves the PR-head/full-history validation flow while adding blob filtering and sparse exclusions; its signature check remains at 28–47. No demonstrated validation bypass follows from the exclusions, but consumers of excluded files are not available. The changelog's CMake image-provenance claim cannot be verified without the installer change.

Remaining review should inspect the omitted workflow HEAD/tests, classifier and installer changes to verify trusted-push write gating, compatible build reuse, MiMo gate completeness and CMake integrity. Integration replay omits 14 reviewed units and is explicitly incomplete. Relevant contracts are A-011/A-017 and T-013/T-054 for artifact integrity and TB-007 for native validation. CI dependency caches are distinct from T-041 consumer KV storage. Available changes do not directly alter authorization, attestation, hop encryption, plaintext handling, billing or fan-helper authority; this is not clearance of omitted source.
